title: NFL Rejects Sorsby Supplemental Draft Bid, Lawsuit Could Follow

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: NFL Rejects Sorsby Supplemental Draft Bid, Lawsuit Could Follow
sources.description: The NFL on Tuesday informed former Texas Tech quarterback Brendan Sorsby—who battled the NCAA in court over eligibility despite betting on his own team and his own teammates—that his petition for a supplemental draft to play in the 2026 NFL season was denied.
